body_markdown:
Security questionnaire software pricing for 2026. Published prices start at $6,000 a year, and Vendr purchase data puts the median contract for the main tools between $14,750 and $33,000.


One of the reasons I built this company was we were trying to sell a B2B SaaS product. One thing I kept running into as we were trying to sell, and I was the CTO then, was running into these questionnaires. Every time we would try to sell into a mid market company, I would get the same question. The same question, the same answer, but slightly worded enough such that you can’t copy paste the previous one.


After the first five questionnaires that you answer, there’s no unique question that comes up. You’ve probably answered that. You’re manually going in, finding the right data, and it’s scattered all over the place.

The tool is helpful in that scenario, but not as helpful as it would be for a mature company, because they don’t have the documents. They don’t have the past questionnaire.


When they hit that series A stage, the number of questionnaires coming in is high.

## Standalone tool or a module in your GRC platform?


There is a category of tools called governance, risk, and compliance automation tools. What they do is help with the process of collecting this evidence. They’ll integrate with your GitHub and say, these people had branch protection turned on. We don’t do that. We’re in the next step of, once you’re done with the certification, give us your data, we’ll help answer these questionnaires for you.


You always start with the SOC 2. As a company, whenever you get started, you need a SOC 2. You buy one thing. Once you buy one thing, there’s going to be the trust center. Then you adopt the questionnaires when you start having them. Where we come in is to graduate to the next level. If this problem is big enough, come to us.

## What drives the price


Imagine we are doing 100 deals. We go to a thousand deals. Every team needs to scale up. The way to solve that problem is, you can throw in more headcount. Instead of one person doing the job, you can hire five more people to do the job, and you can keep the same speed and handle a thousand deals instead of 100. Instead of adding headcount, use AI tokens to get the job done.


We price by the volume of questionnaires that you process. We don’t price by seat or the amount of knowledge that you have, because knowledge keeps changing. We don’t want to charge for that.


We want everyone in the organization to use the tool and benefit, because if we price by seat, security benefits from it and sales doesn’t.


We go into organizations through the security team. We quickly jump into being the sales tool, because sales engineers and salespeople quickly adopt the tool. Even within sales teams, there’s sales engineers using us, account executives using us, customer success folks using us. Why would you charge more for more people using the tool? You should encourage more usage. Instead of pricing by the inputs, you’re pricing by the output.


## How to evaluate a tool


What I’ve seen is that when you upload a real questionnaire and you see the benefit, it immediately resonates with you.


When onboarding, people usually have knowledge bases. You curated that information. You spent time and energy. Upload it. That’s probably the highest quality source of information. You should add that knowledge to have an apples to apples comparison.


The best way is clicking on sources. Seeing where the answer comes from. A lot of people link up their website help center docs for these questionnaires. Those help center docs are sometimes really old. Even three months old is sometimes too old. Then it would have this one sentence where it’s incorrect and things have changed. It’s not an AI hallucination, it’s a human hallucination from a website.


## Where Wolfia fits


All you’re going to do with Wolfia is connect your Google Drives, bring in your existing policies, bring in your existing answers that you’ve previously provided, and let Wolfia figure out the knowledge base. Unless we have a factual piece of information coming from one of your docs, we’re not going to answer it. We’re going to leave it empty. We’re not even going to guess. And when we do, we’re going to give you a citation.


The nice thing with Wolfia is we tell you where every single sentence is coming from. If you feel like that doesn’t make sense, what I would do is remove the sentence and add to the knowledge base. Once you add it to the knowledge base, that’s going to override any other older facts, and your answer is going to be used for all of the foreseeable future.


We provide unlimited users. Trust center is another product that we provide our customers. You have this website where people can come in and request access and then sign an online NDA.


## FAQ


### How much does security questionnaire software cost per year?


Published prices start at $6,000 a year (Wolfia, from $500 a month) and $10,000 a year (Responsive’s Emerging Edition). Most vendors publish no price. Vendr’s purchase data puts the median contract at $14,750 for Responsive, $21,000 for Vanta, $22,500 for Whistic, $24,318 for Loopio and $33,000 for SecurityPal.


### How much does security questionnaire automation cost for a 50-person company?


The options for a 50-person SaaS company run from $6,000 to about $25,000 a year. Wolfia starts at $6,000 a year with unlimited users, Responsive’s Emerging Edition starts at $10,000, and Vendr’s data puts Vanta at $12,000 to $25,000 a year for companies with 1 to 50 employees on a single framework, for the whole compliance platform rather than questionnaires alone.


### Is questionnaire automation cheaper inside a GRC platform like Vanta or Secureframe?


It can be cheaper to start, but the bundled versions are capped. Vanta’s Plus plan includes 25 questionnaires a year and Professional includes 144. Secureframe’s Fundamentals plan, from $7,500 a year, includes 100 AI questionnaire questions a year, fewer than one long questionnaire. Teams that answer more than a few questionnaires a month usually outgrow the bundle.


### Which security questionnaire tools publish their prices?


Wolfia (from $500 a month), Responsive (Emerging Edition from $10,000) and Secureframe (Fundamentals from $7,500 a year) publish a starting price. Vanta, Conveyor, Loopio, SecurityPal, Whistic and HyperComply publish no price and quote every buyer.


### How much does Wolfia cost?


Wolfia plans start at $500 a month. Every plan covers security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, and includes unlimited users. We price based on the number of questionnaires, because ultimately that’s where the value is. That’s the value we are providing.
